spots.name: Oulu Cathedral
spots.summary: Oulu Cathedral is an Evangelical Lutheran cathedral and the seat of the Diocese of Oulu, located in the center of Oulu, Finland. The church was built in 1777 as a tribute to the king of Sweden Gustav III and named after his wife as Sofia Magdalena's church.

spots.name: Toripolliisi
spots.summary: Toripolliisi is a bronze sculpture located at the market square in Oulu, Finland. It was made by sculptor Kaarlo Mikkonen in 1987. The sculpture measures 220×150×112 centimetres, and it was named in honour of the bobbies that once patrolled the market place.

spots.name: Hupisaaret Islands
spots.summary: The Hupisaaret Islands City Park is a public urban park in the Myllytulli district in central Oulu, Finland. The park is located in the delta of the River Oulu. The area was built as a public park in the 1860s, and the first white wooden bridges that characterize the park were also built at the time.

spots.name: Oulu Castle
spots.summary: Oulu Castle was a late defense castle in Oulu, Finland. It was built on an island in the delta of Oulu River in 1590. The castle was mostly made of wood and earth walls. There probably was an earlier medieval castle on the same site latest by 1375.

spots.name: Oulu railway station
spots.summary: The Oulu Railway Station is located in the centre of Oulu, Finland, in the city district of Vaara. All trains are operated by VR. Nearby is the Oulu bus station for long-distance buses.

spots.name: Oulu Market Hall

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: The Oulu Market Hall is a historic market hall in the Market Square, in the centre of Oulu, Finland. The market hall was opened in 1901.

spots.name: Kivisydän
spots.summary: From the French word trottoir, meaning pedestrian street, this is the main shopping street of the city a place for live entertainment mainly during summertime, but also on weekends all year round. Part of the street was renovated and refitted with heating in 2011, which should keep the street ice free even during the coldest winter months.

spots.name: Mannerheim Park
spots.summary: The Mannerheim Park is a small urban park in Vanhatulli district of Oulu, Finland. Renovations finished in 2019 changed the look of the park completely, and made it more suitable for small events. The park is a favorite hangout for many.

spots.name: Market Square, Oulu

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Oulu Market Square is the main market square of the city of Oulu, Finland.

spots.name: Northern Ostrobothnia Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue

spots.summary: The Northern Ostrobothnia Museum is a museum of cultural history. This provincial museum focuses on the city of Oulu and its surrounding Northern Ostrobothnia region. The museum is situated in the Hupisaaret Islands park in the Myllytulli neighbourhood in Oulu, Finland.

names.ja: 北オストロボスニア博物館

spots.name: Tietomaa

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Tietomaa is a science centre in Oulu, Finland. It is located in Myllytulli district near the city centre. It is the first science centre in Finland and it was opened to the public on 29 June 1988.

names.fr: Parcs du fossé de la ville d'Oulu

spots.name: Oulu Prison
spots.summary: The Oulu Prison is a prison located in the Myllytulli neighbourhood in Oulu, Finland. There are 80 prison places, of which ten are reserved for female prisoners. The mean prison population in 2012 was 87.

spots.name: Frans Michael Franzén
spots.summary: Frans Michael Franzén is an outdoor sculpture located in the city centre in Oulu, Finland. It is the oldest public monument in Oulu.

photo.author: Statue by Erland Stenberg (1838–1896)Photo by Estormiz

spots.name: Oulu Museum of Art

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Oulu Museum of Art (OMA) is an art museum in the Myllytulli neighbourhood in Oulu. It is located on the edge of the Hupisaaret Islands park.

spots.name: Nallikari
spots.summary: Nallikari is a seaside resort located on an island in the Hietasaari district in Oulu, Finland. The resort can be reached year-round with the local bus routes 15 and 15N and during summertime with a trackless train called Potnapekka. The beach of Nallikari stretches for about half a kilometre.

spots.name: Holy Trinity Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Holy Trinity Cathedral, Oulu, is an Eastern Orthodox cathedral in Oulu, Finland. The church is located in the Hollihaka district about one kilometre south of the city centre.

spots.name: Oulujoki Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Oulujoki Church is an evangelical Lutheran church in Kirkkokangas neighbourhood in Oulu, Finland.

spots.name: Oulu Theatre
spots.summary: Oulu City Theatre is a municipal theatre in Oulu, Finland. The current theatre building is located in the Vänmanninsaari island close to the market square in the city centre.

spots.name: Oulu Cemetery
spots.summary: The Oulu Cemetery is a cemetery located in the Intiö district close to the city centre of Oulu, Finland.

spots.name: Intiö water tower
spots.summary: The Intiö water tower is an unused water tower in Oulu, Finland. The water tower of the Oulu Waterworks is located in the Intiö district.

spots.name: Oulu City Library

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Oulu City Library is a municipal and regional library in Oulu, Finland. The main library building is located in the city centre near the market square. There are also 24 other library branches in the districts of Oulu and a patient library in Oulu University Hospital.

names.es: Biblioteca de la Ciudad de Oulu

spots.name: Heinätorinpuisto Park
spots.summary: Heinätorinpuisto Park is a public park in the Hollihaka district of Oulu, Finland.

spots.name: Otto Karhi Park
spots.summary: Otto Karhi Park is a public park in the Pokkinen district in the city centre of Oulu, Finland. The park has been named after Otto Karhi, a politician from Oulu.

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Tuira Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Tuira Church is an evangelical Lutheran church in Tuira, Oulu. The church building has been designed by architect Harald Andersin and it was inaugurated as a chapel of Oulu parish in 1916. The parish of Oulu was divided into smaller parishes in 1966 and the chapel in Tuira was inaugurated as a church.

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Sailor's Home Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Sailor’s Home Museum is on the idyllic island of Pikisaari near downtown Oulu. The museum is in the oldest surviving wooden building in Oulu, also known as Matila House, and is the former home of sailor Isak Matilainen.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Karjasilta
spots.summary: Karjasilta is a district in the Höyhtyä area in the city of Oulu, Finland. The district close to the city centre is bordered by the Raksila district to the north, Finnish national road 4 to the east, the Vanhatulli and Limingantulli districts to the west and the Nokela and Höyhtyä districts to the south.

spots.name: St. Luke's Chapel

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St. Luke's Chapel is an evangelical Lutheran church in the University of Oulu Linnanmaa campus in Oulu. The opening service of the academic year is held at St. Luke's chapel. Services in English are held on Sundays.

spots.name: Möljä Bridge
spots.summary: The Möljä Bridge is a concrete beam bridge over the Toppilansalmi strait in Oulu, Finland. The bridge connects districts of Toppila and Toppilansaari. The bridge is 98 metres (322 ft) long, about 20 metres longer than the width of the Toppilansalmi strait at that point. Clearance beneath the bridge is 4 metres (13 ft).

spots.name: University of Oulu Botanical Gardens
spots.summary: The Botanical Garden of the University of Oulu is one of the northernmost scientific gardens in the world. Botanical Garden collection of plants is maintained for teaching and research purposes and it is open to the public.

names.es: Jardín botánico de la Universidad de Oulu

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Raatti Stadium
spots.summary: Raatti Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in the Koskikeskus neighbourhood of Oulu, Finland. In 2011–2026 it was the home stadium of AC Oulu, competing in Finnish top-tier Veikkausliiga, and it is currently used mostly for football matches. The stadium holds 4,392 people.

names.ja: ラーティン・スタディオン

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Heinäpää Football Stadium
spots.summary: Heinäpää Football Stadium is an association football stadium in Oulu, Finland built in 2025–2026. It is the home stadium of AC Oulu of the Veikkausliiga. The all-seater UEFA category 3 stadium has a capacity of 5,080 spectators.

spots.name: Oulu Automobile Museum

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: A car museum with 40 cars and 20 motorcycles and some traffic related paraphernalia on display. A couple of really interesting vehicles like the largest car ever built in the Nordic countries (a truck for a dam company), the remains of a Ford "killed in action" during World War II and a "motorcycle" where the rider sits inside a large wheel. The car museum also has a restaurant open for lunch.

spots.name: Paska Kaupunni graffiti
spots.summary: This iconic graffiti (or at least the nickname which Oulu got from it) is known all around Finland. The term "Paska kaupunki" literally means "Shitty city", and it was adopted from the song with the same name by Kauko Röyhkä. The graffiti appeared on the wall at some point in the 1980s, and after this, the graffiti has been removed numerous times but it has always reappeared on the same spot. The

spots.name: Oulun Suomalaisen Yhteiskoulun Lukio
spots.summary: The Finnish Co-educational Lycée of Oulu was established and opened in 1902 as a private Finnish-language lycée. It was the first co-educational upper secondary school in Oulu, a progressive learning institution at the time since both boys and girls studied in the same school. The students of today keep up the progressive spirit in the school with a wide distribution of information on gender and s

spots.name: Hupisaaret park, Fountains and salmon stairs
spots.summary: The beautiful park of Hupisaaret (lit. Fun Islands) is a lush area with little paths and bridges crossing beautiful little streams. The longest fish path of Finland, 750-m- and 64-stair-long fish path is on the northern part of Hupisaaret park. Take a picnic or just stroll around the renovated park where you can also find the soon-to-be-mentioned Northern Ostrobothnia Museum. Tietomaa and Oulu Mus

spots.name: Oulu Water park
spots.summary: A "water park" meaning a floated obstacle course in the Oulu river delta. Right next to the Oulu castle ruins and cafe, so you can get a coffee or a cold beer after!

spots.name: Tietomaa Science Centre

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: Closed for renovation until 2026 The oldest science museum in the country, mostly kinematic and interactive, great for pre-teens but plenty for adults to enjoy. It is partially located in the former Åström leather factory, and you can ride the glass lift up the 19th-century brick water tower.

spots.name: Kruununmakasiini
spots.summary: In Sweden (to which Finland belonged from the 1300s to 1809), a "Kronomagasin" was a state-administered warehouse in which grain and other foodstuffs collected as tax were stored. Unfortunately, one can't go inside the warehouse any more since today it functions as an office for an architecture company. It is worth checking out from the outside though, the old wooden building sticks out amusingly

spots.name: The Groke Stone
spots.summary: The urban artwork "Mörkökivi" is known amongst the locals, but not so much advertised to travellers. The reason probably is that it is not an official artwork, the artist is unknown, and, to be fair, it is just a simple stone with some paint on it. Yet it is a sympathetic little artwork, even said to be "The pole of Oulu" (figuratively) by some. It depicts a Moomin character "The Groke" and is on

spots.name: Oulu Zipline
spots.summary: A zipline near the beach in Nallikari. It runs for 250 m along the shoreline. It starts from a 20-m-high tower and ends near the Nallikari lighthouse. It is possible for two people to go at the same time.

spots.name: Sokeri-Jussin Kievari

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Finnish "countryside food" restaurant on the island of Pikisaari, accessible by pedestrian bridge from the Market Square. It operates in a former storage building, which is one of the oldest buildings in Oulu. The seaside outdoor seating is a nice place to dine in the summer. Try out reindeer tongue or blood pudding soup!

spots.name: Kaarlenholvi/Jumpru

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Genuine Oulu. Pub downstairs with warmed up patio offers the authentic overview of locals. Nightclub upstairs attracts younger clientele and exchange students. Long queues weekends, so arrive early (before 23:00) to avoid waiting.

spots.summary: Large servings of non-nonsense food, steaks and such at reasonable prices. It used to be right across the street from the railway station, but nowadays neighbours the Forenom apartment hotel.
